findings: Read independently first. No 'Pre-IPO Investors' section for this A+H issuer (no occurrence of 'pre-IPO' in the text). Roster (pdf p173-176): no director is linked to any investor, so nothing supports 1. Candidate's supports_0 rests on (a) waiver condition (iii) (pdf p62), which is a stipulated condition of a waiver for a subset of <5% A-share holders, not a prospectus statement that no pre-IPO investor holds/nominates a seat and not among the confirmations the Company gives; (b) a substantial-shareholder table snippet; (c) generic directors' 'no other relationship' confirmation. None is an explicit statement of no such rights/seat or of no pre-IPO investments. Under the schema (absence of evidence is not 0) this is unresolved. All candidate quotes were verified verbatim and page/printed mapping is correct; the issue is interpretation only. If the project treats an A+H issuer with no disclosed pre-IPO investment programme and a clean roster as 0, that is a policy choice, not established by the text.
residual_uncertainty: Historic institutional investors (Oriental Fortune, Guoke Ruihua etc., 2011-2012, pdf p124) and 2017/2021/2025 A-share placement subscribers (pdf p126) have no disclosed board/observer rights and no seat on the current board, but no explicit negative statement exists. Would flip to supports_0 only if the project accepts waiver condition (iii) plus a clean roster as affirmative evidence.
